nodes.label: Marketing
nodes.description: Reaching the right audience with the right message. Modern tools make targeted, data-driven marketing accessible to businesses of any size.

nodes.label: Sales
nodes.description: Converting interest into revenue. Technology streamlines lead tracking, proposal generation, and customer relationship management.

nodes.label: Customer Service
nodes.description: Supporting customers after the sale. AI-powered tools can provide instant responses while keeping the human touch for complex issues.

nodes.label: Finance
nodes.description: Managing cash flow, invoicing, and financial planning. Automation eliminates manual bookkeeping and surfaces insights that drive better decisions.

nodes.label: Operations
nodes.description: The day-to-day engine of your business. Streamlined workflows, inventory management, and process automation free your team to focus on growth.

nodes.label: Human Resources
nodes.description: Hiring, onboarding, and retaining talent. Modern HR platforms simplify compliance and create better employee experiences.

nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.description: Setting direction and making trade-offs. Data-driven insights help small businesses compete strategically, not just reactively.

nodes.label: Generative AI
nodes.description: AI that creates — text, images, code, and ideas. From drafting proposals to generating marketing copy, it amplifies what a small team can produce.

nodes.label: Cloud Computing
nodes.description: Enterprise-grade infrastructure without the data center. Pay for what you use, scale when you need to, access from anywhere.

nodes.label: Robotic Process Automation
nodes.description: Software robots that handle repetitive tasks — data entry, report generation, system updates — so your people don't have to.

nodes.label: Data Analytics
nodes.description: Turning raw data into actionable insight. Dashboards, trend analysis, and predictive models help you see what's coming, not just what happened.

nodes.label: CRM Systems
nodes.description: A single source of truth for every customer interaction. Modern CRMs integrate with email, phone, social, and web to give you the full picture.

nodes.label: Cybersecurity
nodes.description: Protecting your business and your customers' data. Small businesses are increasingly targeted — modern security tools make defense affordable.

nodes.label: E-Commerce
nodes.description: Selling online with professional-grade storefronts, payment processing, and fulfillment — no longer limited to big retailers.

nodes.label: System Integration
nodes.description: Connecting your tools so data flows automatically between them. Eliminates double-entry, reduces errors, and creates a unified view of your business.

edges.label: Connected workflows, single source of truth
